evidence_lane: finite-dimensional mathematical/structural CPU demonstration, NOT original TabM/Caduceus/DISCO benchmark, no neural model training

controls.RC: Construct exact reverse-complement permutation J on length-16 four-symbol DNA, form even=(R+J R)/2 and odd=(R-J R)/2 representations. Assert J²=I and h(Jx)=P h(x) to 1e-11. Test generic unsymmetrized matrix violates P-equivariance on 5/5 worlds. Functional output under RC is symmetry-equivalent, not new independent expert.
controls.BatchEnsemble: For rectangular input→output W(6x4), construct a nonzero nullspace vector n with n@W=0; generic input-side rank-one r causes (n*r)@W ≠0. This is a counterexample to extracting all input-conditioned TabM branches from only y0=xW; output-side only scaling is exact cheap reconstruction.
controls.operator_splitting: N=16 spatial points, fixed skew circulant transport A and spatially heterogeneous diagonal reaction/damping B. Compare exact exp(dt(A+B)), Lie exp(dt A)exp(dt B), commutator-corrected Lie and Strang exp(dt A/2)exp(dt B)exp(dt A/2) for dt in [0.05,0.1,0.2]. Include B scalar*I as exact commuting null. Never call a commutator correction novel relative to ordinary numerical splitting.

seeds.split_unit: independent random matrices and DNA sequences per world

implementation.rows: one row per world x check / timestep, raw dev and fresh CSV

frozen_gates.algebra_PASS: Every fresh world: J²=I and RC parity <=1e-11, native BatchEnsemble post-output exact <=1e-11, input-code collision full output differs >=1e-4, commuting Lie residual <=1e-11.
frozen_gates.algebra_FAIL: Exact parity mismatch, false same-output collision, noncommuting mismatch mislabeled exact, or unstable matrix exponential results.
frozen_gates.comparison_UNCERTAIN: Finite dt at random worlds may favor or hurt correction vs Strang; report both, no selection from audit. Does NOT measure Mirror-specific utility, compression, TabM TabPFN accuracy or actual Caduceus behavior.

units.dt: time (s) for synthetic normalized ODE, A,B 1/s

uncertainty: max FP64 residuals and paired five-world spread, not statistical 95% CI; time/performance tests not run.
audit_policy: Frozen protocol commit precedes code creation, five fresh worlds run once and are not used to revise analytic setup. Any changed protocol requires separate amendment and fresh seeds.
limitations: Caduceus native is a learned reverse-complement-equivariant Mamba; this toy uses linear intertwiners only. DISCO operator is learned neural, this toy uses exact small linear operators. TabM is more than BatchEnsemble; toy only demonstrates non-shareable input factor algebra.
